main_text.p: anachoretas & solitarios quosdam Ægypti, vix scio an vlla tum virorū examina eiusmodi coe-perint: & magis sub aetatis frequentis initiū istos nidificasse probarim: tantum pastores plerique quos Episcopos & Presbyteros vocabant,iam a vita coniugali pede ita referebat, vt fere in mo-res hoc abiret. Sed nec mulieres ipsæ vel vir-gines ita continentiam affectabant, vt nodum plane stringerent vti deinde accidit:nec domos parentum ea occasione relinquebant: adeo vt minus mali illic fuisse, immo & non parum sæpe virtutis & pietatis videri posit. Attamen in genere omnis illa vitæ informatio, quæ quanuis Dei cultus speciem extra Dei vocationem & Christi gratiæ fidem quærit aut constituit, non potest diu cum beneficij Christi agnitione con-sistere. Sed quemadmodū Similæ amant suos ca-tulos, ita etiam quæ minimi verè in pietatis pro sessione facienda sunt, quia tamen ab humani sensus fundo prodeunt, omnes passim in sui ad-mirationem, plerosque ad æmulationē rapiunt. Quasi vero satis Christianus non esset, qui & in in Christi beneficio salutis omne ratione ponē-ret, atque ita cum sua infirmitate seriō ac per-petuo ex Domini virtute & vocatione lucta-retur. Doctrina denique verae fidei & verorum operum non certo aliquo examine ab Euange-lio petito, sed vt res ferebant recto studio tra-ctabatur. Abstetio item a promiscuis cibis, ob-seruatio quoque memoriae præcipuorū Domi-ni ad salutem nostram operum statis præter die Dominicum diebus huic aetati placere coepit, quum tamen istiusmodi ἐθελοθρησκείας [?] in herba

page.notes: Running head read as "DE ECCLESIA." though the first letter looks like P in the scan. "Abstetio" is doubtful (possibly Abstinentio). "esset" is read from a damaged word ("effet"). The Greek word after "istiusmodi" is uncertain and marked [?]. The Greek letters are read from a blurred scan. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout. The word "in" appears twice in "esset, qui & in in Christi" as printed. The page ends with "in herba" and has no catchword or signature visible.
